$comment: The target list a sweep runs over. Data rather than code so the harness,
a CI job and a human driving the browser by hand all sweep the same thing.
Widths are the phones this app ships to. app.json sets supportsTablet:
false and orientation: portrait, so tablet and landscape are deliberately
absent — auditing them would be auditing a surface the product does not
sell. Heights are the real devices, not round numbers: a short screen is

nativeOnly.$comment: Not reachable on the web build: both drive MediaPipe through react-native-webview, which has no web implementation. Web renders only their failure states. Audit these on a simulator with a clip added via `xcrun simctl addmedia`.

accounts.$comment: Created against a local api-server on .env.local. Never the Railway URL: signing up and deleting accounts writes real rows.

empty.covers: every empty state, and the Coach paywall

populated.covers: trend, band, deltas, a full transcript

notAudited.$comment: Stated so a green sweep is not mistaken for full coverage.
notAudited.voiceOverSpeech: The iOS Simulator ships no VoiceOver engine. Names, roles, grouping and traversal order are checked; what it says is not.
notAudited.android: Never swept. app.json declares com.fourformai.app for Android.
notAudited.dynamicType: Simulator only, via `xcrun simctl ui <udid> content_size`, and the app must be relaunched to pick it up.
